### Integrate with GCP bucket
- Pandas accept URLs with the prefix "gcs://", and will use gcsfs to complete the IO operation.
- The IO functions take an argument storage_options, which will be passed to GCSFileSystem, for example:

**Write DataFrame to Google Cloud Storage**
```
df.to_pickle('gs://bucket-name/path/file-name.pkl', <other parameters>,  storage_options={"token": "credentials.json"})
```
**Read DataFrame from Google Cloud Storage**
```
df.read_pickle('gs://bucket-name/path/file-name.pkl', <other parameters>,  storage_options={"token": "credentials.json"})
```
